没有风。没有发动机。
No wind. No engine.
也没有人推它。
And no one is pushing.
没有发动机，谁在推它？
No engine. What moves this boat?
答案，藏在船尾。
The answer is at the stern.
一小块樟脑，接触着水。
A small piece of camphor touches the water.
分子不断释放，进入水与界面。
Molecules enter the water and its surface.
随机运动，把分子扩散开。
Random motion spreads them by diffusion.
船尾附近，樟脑分子更多。
More camphor accumulates near the stern.
这些分子改变了界面自由能。
These molecules change the interfacial free energy.
在这里，水面的张力降低。
Here, the surface tension falls.
前方较高，后方较低。
Higher ahead. Lower behind.
差异沿水面分布，形成梯度。
A variation along the surface creates a gradient.
它既有大小，也有方向。
The gradient has both magnitude and direction.
水面从低张力处流向高张力处。
The surface flows from low to high tension.
这就是马兰戈尼效应。
This is the Marangoni effect.
但水的流向，不等于船的受力。
Water flow and force on the boat are different.
前后张力不对称，产生向前合力。
Unequal tension creates a forward resultant.
合力与水动力，共同决定运动。
Capillary and hydrodynamic forces set the motion.
樟脑的储量，却是有限的。
The supply of camphor is finite.
释放减弱，前后差异逐渐缩小。
As release weakens, the difference fades.
驱动变弱，阻力让小船减速。
Less drive. Drag slows the boat.
供给耗尽，运动最终停下。
When the supply runs out, motion dies away.
它没有发动机。
It has no engine.
但它并非没有能量来源。
But it does have an energy source.
樟脑释放，消耗化学自由能。
Camphor release spends chemical free energy.
维持不均匀，也在持续耗散。
Maintaining the gradient also dissipates energy.
这是非平衡系统，不是永动机。
A nonequilibrium system, not perpetual motion.
真正驱动它的，是水面上微小的不均匀。
What moves it is a tiny imbalance at the surface.
